title: Minimal valid SendRRData with full command-specific prefix
purpose: Repair earlier malformed SendRRData ideas by using the documented interface handle and timeout prefix followed by the common Null Address Item and a minimally non-empty Unconnected Data Item.
expected_behavior: The parser should accept a valid SendRRData command-specific structure, consume the CPF item count and the documented Null Address Item plus Unconnected Data Item combination, and forward the small unconnected payload.
constraints_preserved: Length field is 0x0012 and matches 18 command-specific bytes.
SendRRData prefix includes 4-byte interface handle and 2-byte timeout before CPF.
First item is Null Address Item 0x0000 with length 0.
Second item is Unconnected Data Item 0x00b2 with length 2.
All multibyte numeric fields are little-endian.
issue_safety_notes: This replaces malformed prior transport shapes with a valid low-size structure and does not attempt any issue replay.
